title: Make dashboard journeys fit the default timeout under load

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Maintained proof detects retry-progress wording that names the default Claude Code host while the retained execution start actually belongs to Codex. The catch is `expect(card).toContainText(words)` in `dashboard/tests/support/codexRetryPage.ts:28`, reached by `dashboard/tests/launches/agent-launch-start-codex.spec.ts:40`. This verdict covers the retained retry on the initiating page; the faulted run stops at that earlier assertion, before its fresh-page assertions.

**Next proof action:** Keep this maintained exact-host assertion. This check supplies no evidence requiring a proof repair for the observed path. A separate fault targeting only fresh-page behavior would need its own check if the caller wants that additional claim; it is outside this bounded probe.

The selected source is `.planning/seeds/SEED-287-dashboard-journeys-within-default-timeout.md#fit-dashboard-journeys-in-default-timeout`, particularly preserving distinct behavioral promises while reducing dashboard journey cost. The tested revision is `47e99704c73b32cd26a0d47439adc227bfdb8a14` (implementation composition `694e6d91`, supplied by the caller). The existing retained-workspace Codex retry case and its helper were inspected against that revision. No new repair decision or follow-up implementation was made; the evidence supports the existing preserved proof.

One isolated scratch worktree was created for this check at `/private/tmp/seed287-final-intent-coverage-20261112`, on temporary branch `codex/seed287-final-intent-coverage-20261112`, starting at the selected revision. The originating execution checkout was `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/make-dashboard-journeys-fit-the-default-timeout`. Its files, index, branch, process log, backlog and CI observer were left alone. No shared stash was used. The scratch pre-probe state was tracked-clean, with only this check's removable dependency symlink untracked.

The suggested fresh-page-specific default-host fault was narrowed to a direct progress-rendering fault: in `dashboard/src/StartupStatus.tsx:93`, replace `running?.host ?? host` with `"claude"`. This models substituting the page's default host for the actual retained/running host. It leaves the server's retained Codex start, native behavior, fixtures and all assertions unchanged. The maintained fixture's Codex refusal first establishes the retained workspace, then retries with creation held. A trap restored the single edited source file from the selected revision even on failure or interruption.

All three runs used the same focused command through the maintained configuration:

`caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard -- tests/launches/agent-launch-start-codex.spec.ts --workers=2`

Each run requested its own strict proof record using `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_PROOF_RECORD`. Each selected and actually executed exactly one Chromium case, with retry 0, the unchanged default 30 s case budget and 5 s browser observation. The named selection uses the maintained independent focused-run admission path.

- Baseline passed, exit 0, strict and runner verdicts passed: `/tmp/seed287-ic-baseline-20261112.json`.
- The single fault failed, exit 1, strict and runner verdicts failed: `/tmp/seed287-ic-fault-20261112.json`. The exact HTTP `runningStarts` assertion completed before the card assertion failed after its 5,000 ms observation. The failure's card showed `Starting execution in Claude Code…` while its assignment named Codex.
- Wrong behavior was independently observed in retained trace data: four HTTP 200 `/__agent-launch` responses showed both `starts[0].host` and `keptStarts[0].host` as `codex`, workflow `execution`, identity `SEED-A#a`, phase `launching`, and the kept workspace `~/git/open-dough/.worktrees/story-a`. The later DOM frame snapshot at trace timestamp 5864.414 showed the same retry card (`aria-describedby="_r_g_"`) rendering `Starting execution in Claude Code…`. This establishes the actual HTTP-to-DOM mismatch, beyond merely observing that edited code ran. Preserved evidence: `/tmp/seed287-ic-fault-trace-20261112.zip`, `/tmp/seed287-ic-fault-network-20261112.json`, and `/tmp/seed287-ic-fault-dom-20261112.json`.
- Restoration passed, exit 0, strict and runner verdicts passed: `/tmp/seed287-ic-restored-20261112.json`. The unchanged complete case again exercised current-card progress, an independently opened page, reload, the creation barrier and successful retained-workspace completion. Tracked and index diffs were empty at the original revision. The dependency symlink was removed, scratch status was clean, and the scratch-path process check found no survivors. The owned clean worktree and temporary branch were retired successfully. No commit or push occurred.

Actual machine conditions: Battery Power, 98% then 97%, discharging; the lid was open (`AppleClamshellState = No`) before and after the short focused runs. Commands ran under `caffeinate -s -i`; `-s` was inert on battery, so this used the documented awake/open-lid `-i` fallback. The macOS sleep-log query found no Entering Sleep/Wake-from entries during the 14:54–14:59 local window containing all runs. These are short focused observations, with no claim of AC execution, load-stress coverage, full-local timing or whole-suite speedup.

- **Test runtime.** Measured from the strict runner records: baseline 10,149.618 ms, fault 11,360.742 ms, restored 6,674.519 ms; total 28,184.879 ms. Their individual case durations were 5,301 ms, 9,061 ms and 4,651 ms; total 19,013 ms. Runner duration includes setup/teardown; case duration does not include all shared preparation.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separately timed human-work interval was recorded for this probe. The parent supplied authorization and a short power-condition disposition; this does not establish a human-effort duration.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable as a separate effort measure: no metered active-agent time or token accounting was exposed for this worker. Invocation elapsed below is wall time including lookup, setup, execution, evidence inspection, restoration and cleanup, rather than a separately measured effort value.

## Story Wrap Up disposition

Checked revision:47e99704c73b32cd26a0d47439adc227bfdb8a14 (code694e6d91).
Accept Caught only for retained Codex retry progress on the initiating page.
The earlier maintained card assertion stops the faulted run before fresh-page
checks, so this probe establishes no fresh-page-only mutation claim. Keep the
existing exact-host assertion; no actual delivered defect or new proof repair
is evidenced, and no follow-up is needed. Baseline/fault/restored observations,
independent HTTP/DOM mismatch, exact restoration, clean scratch retirement and
actual battery/open-lid sleep conditions are retained above. Full story protection
continues to rest on its maintained proof and complete CI, beyond this one probe.
